meta.name: mtt
meta.author: Chax0180
meta.description:
Aims to completely redesign almost all of Mindustry's block textures, primarily on Serpulo. Changes some sounds as well. Makes no change to gameplay, only visuals.
[royal]Features:[]
- Numerous block resprites
- Expanded item descriptions
- Slight alteration of phase fabric's overall design & name
- New sounds for fires and Corvus lasers
- Various small text changes in menus and the sector information panel.
